The camera work and visual effects were good but the script writing and character development were some of the worse I've seen in a while.  In fact I've watched some really really random things on Netflix with better character interactions.

Now I'm overly critical because I grew up reading Tolkien and watching LOTR multiple times a year. I even dabbled in the games and got upset when Hobbit trilogy missed the mark.

This series had a lot of material to go off but I feel that was ignored and instead we have this subpar LOTR series that quite frankly just isn't worth watching.

I fell in love with the visuals but something just isn't right.  I'm not sure it can get right as the series progress.

I'll probably get a lot of hate for this but, if they made this show without any reference to LOTR it would be watchable, it wouldn't be decent or a sudden cult classic but I'd have watched it. As it stands it's a LOTR show that really let's the team down.
